title: The Small Tide
author: Gideon Ravensworth
blurb: Marguerite Quintana, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
